_comment: Scripted multi-turn conversations for src/agent/core-memory-multiturn.live.test.ts. Each starts from `established` and carries core memory across its turns. `factTurn` (0-based) is the turn that states a core fact; the other turns hold nothing core memory should keep. `expect` (case-insensitive regex) matches the blocks once the fact is written. `stale` matches a line that states the superseded value; once the fact is written, such a line should be gone or say it is past. `anchors` names one fact per established line; every whole-block rewrite should keep those the scenario's `stale` doesn't supersede, plus the scenario's own `keep`. `buried` facts are new, `update` facts change an established one.

established.content:
Name: Samuel Carter
Role: backend engineer at Northwind Logistics
Location: Lisbon, Portugal (Europe/Lisbon)
Family: partner Alex; sister Jo
- Home server migration to NixOS (in progress)

turns: What's the difference between an A record and a CNAME?
And how long does DNS propagation usually take these days?
Good to know. I'm building a tide-times app for sailors called Tidepool on weekends and just bought tidepool.app. Should the bare domain or www be the canonical one?
Do I need to do anything special for HTTPS on a .app domain?
Great, thanks.
scenarios.note: Active project, mentioned while asking about DNS. Rewriting active_projects has to keep the NixOS line.

turns: I want to cook more during the week. What are some staples worth keeping in the cupboard?
How long does cooked rice keep in the fridge?
Can you suggest a quick weeknight dinner? It has to be gluten-free, I was diagnosed as coeliac last month.
How should I store the leftovers?
Perfect, I'll try it tonight.
scenarios.note: Standing dietary constraint, mentioned while asking for a recipe.

turns: What's a good way to spend a rainy Saturday in Lisbon?
Any museum you'd pick over the others?
My brother Tom is flying in from Toronto next week, it's his first time in Portugal. What should we definitely do with him?
Is tram 28 worth the queue?
Thanks, that's a plan.
scenarios.note: Close family, mentioned while planning a visit. Who Tom is belongs in core memory; the visit is an event.

turns: What is a Gantt chart actually useful for?
What tools do people use to make them?
I've gone part-time, so I only work Monday to Wednesday now. Could you draft a short out-of-office message for Thursdays and Fridays?
Make it a bit friendlier.
That's the one, thanks.
scenarios.note: Standing schedule, mentioned while asking for a draft.

turns: What's the weather usually like in northern Portugal in October?
We've just moved from Lisbon up to Porto, so I'll find out soon enough. Which neighbourhoods are nice for a Sunday walk?
Any good francesinha places near there?
Brilliant, thanks.
scenarios.note: Location changes; the timezone stays Europe/Lisbon.

turns: What's the idiomatic way to handle nullable values in Kotlin?
How do sealed classes compare to enums?
Useful. I left Northwind last month and I'm at Monzo now, where everything is Kotlin. How do coroutines compare to Python's asyncio?
What's structured concurrency, in one paragraph?
scenarios.note: Employer changes, mentioned while asking a Kotlin question.

turns: Is it worth running Home Assistant on a Raspberry Pi?
The NixOS migration is finally done, everything's running on the new box. Next up is a garden irrigation controller on an ESP32. Which soil moisture sensor should I get?
How often should it water in summer?
Thanks, ordering the parts now.
scenarios.note: One project finishes and another starts. The finished one no longer belongs in active_projects; a NixOS line still in progress is the failure.
